description: Select project.services so Service can list owned services scoped to owned projects (the public list API).

patches.value:
query project($id: String!) {
  project(id: $id) {
    baseEnvironment {
      canAccess
      canvasGroupRefs
      configEtag
      createdAt
      deletedAt
      id
      isEphemeral
      name
      projectId
      unmergedChangesCount
      updatedAt
    }
    baseEnvironmentId
    botPrEnvironments
    createdAt
    deletedAt
    description
    expiredAt
    featureFlags
    focusedPrEnvironments
    id
    isPublic
    isTempProject
    members {
      avatar
      email
      id
      name
      role
    }
    name
    prDeploys
    primaryEnvironmentId
    subscriptionPlanLimit
    subscriptionType
    team {
      adoptionLevel
      avatar
      createdAt
      id
      name
      preferredRegion
      slackChannelId
      supportTierOverride
      updatedAt
    }
    teamId
    updatedAt
    workspace {
      adoptionLevel
      allowDeprecatedRegions
      avatar
      banReason
      createdAt
      discordRole
      has2FAEnforcement
      hasAutomaticDiagnosis
      hasGuardrailsAccess
      hasHipaaBAA
      hasSAML
      id
      name
      plan
      preferredRegion
      redactedDueTo2FAPending
      slackChannelId
      subscriptionModel
      subscriptionPlanLimit
      supportTierOverride
      updatedAt
      usersWithout2FA
    }
    workspaceId
    services(first: 50) {
      edges {
        node {
          createdAt
          deletedAt
          id
          name
          projectId
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
